T: The price is wrong. The food is right.
D: A failed hockey player discovers he can hit a golf ball a mile and joins the pro tour to save his grandma's house.
P: Serve the beer when Happy goes to his happy place.
S: Thick little chuck patties seared hard, cheddar melted on, in soft slider buns with pickles, onion and a smoky burger sauce. Shape 600g chuck mince into 8 thick rounds like pucks and season well. Sear in a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side, lay a half slice of cheddar on each and cover for 1 minute to melt. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and a pinch of smoked paprika. Toast 8 slider buns and fill with the patties, sauce, sliced pickles and thin onion.
Cheddar and cream cheese balls rolled in toasted pecans

Cream cheese, cheddar, Worcestershire and spring onion rolled into golf ball sizes, coated in toasted crushed pecans, on toothpicks. Beat 250g cream cheese with 150g grated cheddar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 2 chopped spring onions. Roll into golf ball sizes and chill 30 minutes. Toast 100g pecans, crush and roll the balls in them. Spear each with a toothpick.
Fluffy buttermilk biscuits served warm with butter and honey
Buttermilk biscuits: flour, cold butter and buttermilk folded and cut, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with butter and honey.
M: lunch at the pro tour clubhouse

Rump seared hard and sliced thin on toasted ciabatta with buttery slow-cooked onions, melted Swiss and horseradish mayo, with a handful of rocket. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Season 800g rump and sear in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes and slice thin. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp horseradish. Split and toast 4 ciabatta rolls, pile on steak and onions, top with 4 slices Swiss and grill until melted. Add rocket and the horseradish mayo.
Beef and pork meatloaf with a tomato glaze, mash and peas
Beef and pork mince mixed lightly with breadcrumbs soaked in milk, grated onion and egg, shaped in a loaf tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash and peas.
W: Shortbread base with tart lemon filling, dusted with powdered sugar
Buttery shortbread base under a sharp lemon custard, baked until just set and showered with icing sugar.
K: Lager and lemon soda over lemon wheels, served by the pitcher

Two big chilled jugs of cold lager topped with fresh lemon soda made from lemon juice, sugar syrup and soda water, with lemon wheels. Chill two big jugs in the freezer for 20 minutes. Stir the juice of 3 lemons with 60ml sugar syrup and 500ml cold soda water. Pour 1L cold lager into each jug down the side, then top each with half the lemon soda. Add lemon wheels and pour into chilled glasses.

s.note: Cheddar and cream cheese balls rolled in toasted pecans
s.how: Beat 250g cream cheese with 150g grated cheddar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 2 chopped spring onions. Roll into golf ball sizes and chill 30 minutes. Toast 100g pecans, crush and roll the balls in them. Spear each with a toothpick.

s.note: Fluffy buttermilk biscuits served warm with butter and honey
s.how: Rub 100g cold butter into 300g flour with 3 tsp baking powder and salt. Stir in 250ml buttermilk, fold the dough over itself a few times and cut into rounds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve warm with butter and honey.

m.note: Beef and pork meatloaf with a tomato glaze, mash and peas
m.how: Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion and 1 egg. Press into a loaf tin, glaze with 4 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for an hour. Serve with mash and peas.

w.note: Shortbread base with tart lemon filling, dusted with powdered sugar
w.how: Press 200g plain flour, 60g icing sugar and 150g soft butter into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170C for 20 minutes. Whisk 4 eggs, 300g sugar, 40g flour and 150ml lemon juice with the zest of 2 lemons, pour over the hot base and bake 22 minutes until just set. Cool, dust with icing sugar and cut into bars.

d.note: Lager and lemon soda over lemon wheels, served by the pitcher
d.how: Chill two big jugs in the freezer for 20 minutes. Stir the juice of 3 lemons with 60ml sugar syrup and 500ml cold soda water. Pour 1L cold lager into each jug down the side, then top each with half the lemon soda. Add lemon wheels and pour into chilled glasses.
